bar_and_session.early_close_liquidation: fifth completed bar before scheduled close

payload.claim_boundary: Prospective design evidence only. This specification contains no market outcomes and supports no claim of edge, profitability, validation eligibility, Olympics eligibility, deployment readiness, or capital eligibility.

data_dependencies.future_data: prohibited except the next exact bar open exposed after signal

no_signal: common eligibility or state gate fails
pullback duration, depth, structure, anchor, or volume contraction fails
proposal: all gates pass and positive initial risk exists

payload.direction_scope_rule: This specification exercises the long arm explicitly permitted by the revision-1 hypothesis. The short arm remains unspecified and unauthorized.
payload.economic_mechanism: The first controlled retracement may supply liquidity for continuation while preserving the drive's information content.

entry.intended_timestamp: exactly the signal timestamp (next left-labeled minute)
pre_entry_invalidation: entry timestamp outside the frozen entry window
raw or cost-adjusted entry at or below rounded stop

event_ordering: validate all identities, provenance, calendar, halt, corporate-action, and bar integrity
apply post-halt, price, and one-entry state gates
calculate causal ATR and local-volume series from completed bars only
select earliest eligible impulse and its earliest running-low anchor
select first pullback and evaluate structural invalidations
resolve the next exact bar and pre-entry invalidations
round stop, apply entry friction, and calculate rounded fixed 2R target
emit one immutable proposal or one terminal non-proposal decision
expected_failure_modes: modeled costs and adverse selection exceed the gross effect
opening drive is temporary auction pressure
qualifying events are too infrequent for a defensible conclusion
halt or corporate-action exclusions materially limit coverage

indicators.atr20: Wilder ATR20 over completed regular-session bars; first true range is high-low and each later true range is max(high-low, abs(high-prior close), abs(low-prior close)); seed is the arithmetic mean of the first 20 true ranges, then ATR=(19*prior_ATR+TR)/20; reset after every timestamp gap and session boundary; current trigger bar included
indicators.impulse_volume_mean: arithmetic mean of impulse-end bar and prior four bars
indicators.local_five_bar_volume_ratio: For candidate impulse-end index i, require 25 consecutive completed bars i-24 through i; divide mean volume of i-4 through i by median volume of i-24 through i-5; baseline must be positive
indicators.pullback_volume_mean: arithmetic mean from pullback-start bar through trigger bar inclusive

integrity_expectations: strictly increasing unique bars from scheduled open
finite positive OHLC with valid ranges and nonnegative volume
one security identity, symbol, and session per evaluation
no bar ending after the decision cutoff
complete halt coverage and immutable halt provenance
complete corporate-action coverage and valid adjustment lineage
exact next-bar security, symbol, session, timestamp, feed, and provenance binding
zero look-ahead beyond the explicitly isolated next-bar open
invalidation_conditions: pullback duration below 2 or above 10 completed bars
any pullback close strictly below the 50% retracement
any post-impulse low strictly below the impulse-anchor low
pullback mean volume greater than or equal to impulse mean volume
next raw or cost-adjusted entry at or below rounded stop
payload.market_assumption: A directional opening drive with broad participation can reveal informed demand before slower traders complete their orders.

missing_data_behavior.halt_covered_gap: ATR and consecutive indicators reset; unavailable until rewarmed
missing_data_behavior.missing_local_volume_window: unavailable if a price-qualified impulse has no ratio and no later eligible impulse exists

numeric_semantics.cent_rounding_input: convert binary64 to its shortest round-trip decimal string before decimal floor or ceiling quantization to 0.01
numeric_semantics.comparison_tolerance: none; apply the stated strict or inclusive operator directly
numeric_semantics.median_20: sort ascending and take the arithmetic mean of the values at zero-based indices 9 and 10
numeric_semantics.operation_rounding: round to nearest, ties to even

setup.first_pullback_start: The earliest completed bar after impulse end whose low is strictly below the immediately preceding completed bar low.
setup.impulse_anchor: Scan completed bars from 09:31. Maintain the earliest running minimum low beginning at 09:30; replace the anchor only on a strictly lower low.
setup.impulse_end: The earliest completed bar no later than 10:00 whose high is at least 3% above the then-current anchor low and whose local five-bar volume ratio is at least 2.0. The trigger bar is never an impulse candidate.
setup.pullback_membership: All completed bars from first-pullback start through the candidate trigger bar inclusive.
setup.pullback_structure: Duration is 2 through 10 bars inclusive; depth is 0.20 through 0.50 inclusive; every pullback close is at or above the 50% retracement; every post-impulse low is at or above the impulse-anchor low; and pullback mean volume is strictly less than impulse mean volume.
setup.signal_timestamp: exclusive end of the completed trigger bar
setup.trigger: The earliest eligible completed pullback bar that closes strictly above the immediately preceding completed bar high.

stop_target_and_lifecycle.gap_through_stop: exit at minimum of bar open and stop
stop_target_and_lifecycle.gap_through_target: exit at maximum of bar open and target
stop_target_and_lifecycle.halt_exit: No entry while halted; an open position exits at the first executable post-halt bar under the same conservative precedence.
stop_target_and_lifecycle.post_rejection_evaluation: Only an accepted entry is recorded in prior-entry state. A no-signal, unavailable, or no-trade decision does not itself prohibit evaluation of a later bar against the same first pullback while all duration and time gates still pass.
stop_target_and_lifecycle.reentry: maximum one accepted entry per symbol-session; once prior-entry state contains this strategy, every later evaluation is no-signal
stop_target_and_lifecycle.same_bar_precedence: gap stop, intrabar stop, gap target, intrabar target
stop_target_and_lifecycle.session_exit: Exit on the earlier of timeout or the 15:55 completed-bar close; on an early close use the fifth completed bar before scheduled close.

shared_risk_model.portfolio_admission: apply the unchanged shared exposure, concurrency, and daily-loss gates; this specification may not override or reorder them
shared_risk_model.requested_shares: floor(risk_budget_usd / (cost-adjusted entry - rounded stop)); whole shares only and zero shares is no-trade

stop_target_and_lifecycle.target: cost-adjusted entry plus 2 times initial per-share risk
stop_target_and_lifecycle.unrounded_stop: pullback low minus 0.05 times ATR20 at trigger

tie_breaking: earliest timestamp for equal running-minimum anchor lows
